Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Advising a Friend on Organizing a 1-Day Field Trip for English Students
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your friend, an English teacher, who plans to organize a one-day outdoor field trip for her students and is asking for your advice. Write an email responding to her:

- Advise whether she should choose the city museum or the central park
- Suggest suitable food to bring along or whether to eat at a restaurant
- Recommend whether students should share their experience after the trip by writing a letter/essay or recording a video
title: Task 1.1: Advising a Friend on Organizing a 1-Day Field Trip for English Students
content:
You have received an email from your friend, an English teacher, who plans to organize a one-day outdoor field trip for her students and is asking for your advice. Write an email responding to her:

- Advise whether she should choose the city museum or the central park
- Suggest suitable food to bring along or whether to eat at a restaurant
- Recommend whether students should share their experience after the trip by writing a letter/essay or recording a video

body.answer: I believe you should choose the central park for a one-day outdoor field trip instead of the city museum.
body.example: You can organize an English speaking treasure hunt on the grass, which is much livelier than walking quietly inside a museum.
body.reason: Being outdoors in fresh air is beneficial to the students' physical and mental health, and the open space helps them build a strong sense of belonging through team games.
body.requirement: Advise whether to choose the city museum or the central park

body.answer: Why don't you ask students to bring simple packed lunches instead of eating at a restaurant?
body.example: Students can bring sandwiches, fresh fruit, and bottled water to share on picnic mats under the trees at noon.
body.reason: Bringing packed food is fast, convenient, and fits comfortably within the students' budget without wasting time waiting for restaurant service.
body.requirement: Suggest suitable food to bring along or whether to eat at a restaurant

body.answer: From my point of view, I think that asking students to record a short video is better than writing a letter or essay.
body.example: Each student can record a two-minute clip talking about their favorite game in the park and share it in your class group chat.
body.reason: Making a video helps students make the most of new technology, practice speaking naturally, and allow their brain to exercise creatively.
body.requirement: Recommend whether students should share their experience by writing a letter/essay or recording a video

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Advantages and Disadvantages of Children Learning Musical Instruments
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Nowadays, many parents enroll their children in extracurricular music classes to learn how to play musical instruments. While music lessons can nurture talent and discipline, they may also add pressure and take away children's free time."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of letting children learn to play musical instruments. Support your arguments with specific reasons and examples.
title: Task 2.1: Advantages and Disadvantages of Children Learning Musical Instruments
content:
Read the following statement:

"Nowadays, many parents enroll their children in extracurricular music classes to learn how to play musical instruments. While music lessons can nurture talent and discipline, they may also add pressure and take away children's free time."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of letting children learn to play musical instruments. Support your arguments with specific reasons and examples.

body1.example: For instance, practicing guitar or piano for 30 minutes each day improves a child's memory and helps them relax after hard school lessons.
body1.focus: Advantages: Brain exercise, focus, and healthy relaxation
body1.frame: Firstly, the first reason is that [ld1]... / Advantages (Body Chunk B)
body1.point: Learning musical instruments allows children's brains to exercise creatively, improves their focus, and helps them relieve stress in a positive way.

body2.example: For example, buying a piano and paying for private lessons is expensive, and tight practice schedules can make tired children lose playtime with friends.
body2.focus: Disadvantages: High costs and extra pressure on free time
body2.point: However, music classes cost a great deal of money, time, and effort, and children may feel stressed if parents force them to practice instead of listening to their feelings.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, learning musical instruments benefits children's minds and creativity, provided that parents choose affordable lessons and respect their children's free time.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.2: Advising a Visiting Foreign Friend on Winter Clothes, Activities, and Souvenirs
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from a foreign friend who is planning to visit your country this winter and asked for your suggestions. Write an email responding to your friend:

- Suggest suitable clothes to pack for the winter weather
- Recommend enjoyable outdoor activities to experience during their visit
- Suggest meaningful local souvenirs they can buy for their family and friends
title: Task 1.2: Advising a Visiting Foreign Friend on Winter Clothes, Activities, and Souvenirs
content:
You have received an email from a foreign friend who is planning to visit your country this winter and asked for your suggestions. Write an email responding to your friend:

- Suggest suitable clothes to pack for the winter weather
- Recommend enjoyable outdoor activities to experience during their visit
- Suggest meaningful local souvenirs they can buy for their family and friends

body.answer: I believe you should pack a warm jacket, a few long-sleeved shirts, and comfortable walking shoes.
body.example: If you visit northern areas like Hanoi, wearing a light scarf and a warm coat will help you walk around without catching a cold.
body.frame: G. Provide Instruction / Suggestion + K. Mẫu câu Thân mật hay gặp
body.reason: The winter air can get chilly and windy in the morning and evening, so warm layers will protect your physical health while we do a lot of walking around the town.
body.requirement: Suggest suitable clothes to pack for the winter weather

body.answer: Why don't you take a walking food tour in the old quarter and visit a local flower market or lake?
body.example: When it comes to food, you certainly shouldn't miss hot Pho on a cold morning, and we can walk around Hoan Kiem Lake in the afternoon.
body.frame: G. Provide Instruction / Suggestion + K. Mẫu câu Thân mật hay gặp
body.reason: Outdoor sightseeing gives you the opportunity to broaden your mind and gain a deeper understanding of our people, culture, and tradition.
body.requirement: Recommend enjoyable outdoor activities to experience during their visit

body.answer: From my point of view, I think that traditional handicrafts, silk scarves, or Vietnamese coffee packets are the best souvenirs.
body.example: You can buy boxes of roasted coffee for your friends and handmade ceramic cups for your parents at the night market.
body.reason: Buying local products supports domestic farmers and local workers directly, and these small items are easy to pack in your suitcase.
body.requirement: Suggest meaningful local souvenirs to buy for family and friends

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.2: Advantages and Disadvantages of Working from Home
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Thanks to advancements in digital technology, working from home has become increasingly widespread among modern employees and companies. While remote work offers flexibility and saves commuting time, it also presents challenges such as isolation and blurred work-life boundaries."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of working from home. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.
title: Task 2.2: Advantages and Disadvantages of Working from Home
content:
Read the following statement:

"Thanks to advancements in digital technology, working from home has become increasingly widespread among modern employees and companies. While remote work offers flexibility and saves commuting time, it also presents challenges such as isolation and blurred work-life boundaries."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of working from home. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, working from home lets parents join morning meetings on a laptop without sitting in heavy traffic, giving them more time to cook dinner with family.
body1.focus: Advantages: Flexible time, quiet space, and less commuting
body1.frame: Firstly, the first reason is that [ld1]... / Advantages (Body Chunk B)
body1.point: Working from home is fast and convenient for busy people, saves travel time and money, and helps workers reach a healthy balance between work and family time.

body2.example: For example, remote workers who stay alone all week miss face-to-face teamwork and often keep checking work emails late at night because work and rest happen in the same room.
body2.focus: Disadvantages: Loneliness and blurred work-life boundaries
body2.point: However, working remotely reduces face-to-face interaction with colleagues, makes people feel lonely, and can lead to working overtime when office hours are unclear.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, working from home offers great flexibility and saves commuting time, yet employees should set clear working hours and stay connected with teammates to avoid isolation.

intro.ld1: save commuting time and enjoy flexible schedules
intro.ld2: dealing with loneliness and unclear work-life limits

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.3: Informal Email About Relocating to a New City for Work
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have recently moved to a new city for a new job, and your close friend has sent you an email asking how everything is going. Write an informal email responding to your friend:

- Describe your new workplace, colleagues, and daily routine
- Share your impressions of the new city and your living accommodation
- Invite your friend to visit you in the new city soon
title: Task 1.3: Informal Email About Relocating to a New City for Work
content:
You have recently moved to a new city for a new job, and your close friend has sent you an email asking how everything is going. Write an informal email responding to your friend:

- Describe your new workplace, colleagues, and daily routine
- Share your impressions of the new city and your living accommodation
- Invite your friend to visit you in the new city soon

body.answer: I would like to give you information on my new job: I work at a modern software office downtown, and my colleagues are very friendly and supportive.
body.example: Every weekday, I wake up at 7:00 AM, grab a quick coffee, work from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM, and then walk home to cook dinner.
body.frame: D. Provide Information + K. Informal Chunks (New place/job)
body.reason: Life can be quite hectic at first, but things always get smoother with time as I adjust and adapt to the social environment at work.
body.requirement: Describe your new workplace, colleagues, and daily routine

body.answer: From my point of view, this coastal city is clean, peaceful, and much less crowded than my old city, and I rent a bright one-bedroom apartment near the river.
body.example: There is a small balcony with green plants, and the local supermarket is only a five-minute walk away.
body.frame: H. Provide Opinion + D. Provide Information (A-R-E: Peace & Privacy)
body.reason: My apartment fits comfortably within my budget and offers a quiet, cozy environment where I can put my feet up and recharge my batteries after work.
body.requirement: Share your impressions of the new city and your living accommodation

body.answer: Why don't you come and visit me next month during the long weekend? You can stay in my guest room so you don't need to book a hotel.
body.example: Just let me know your train or flight schedule so I can take a day off and show you around the night market.
body.frame: G. Provide Instruction / Suggestion + K. Informal Chunks
body.reason: Spending a weekend together will give us time to catch up face-to-face, enjoy fresh local food, and visit famous beaches nearby.
body.requirement: Invite your friend to visit you in the new city soon

closing.topic: my new city and new job

opening.fill: my new job and life after moving to Da Nang

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.3: Positive and Negative Impacts of Tourism Development
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"In recent decades, the rapid development of tourism has brought significant economic opportunities to many regions, yet it has also raised concerns about environmental damage and local cultural preservation."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the positive and negative impacts of tourism development. Give reasons and relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
title: Task 2.3: Positive and Negative Impacts of Tourism Development
content:
Read the following statement:

"In recent decades, the rapid development of tourism has brought significant economic opportunities to many regions, yet it has also raised concerns about environmental damage and local cultural preservation."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the positive and negative impacts of tourism development. Give reasons and relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

body1.example: For instance, my cousin's coastal hometown opened small family hotels and food stalls for tourists, which doubled local incomes and funded better roads.
body1.focus: Positive impacts: economic growth and cultural exchange
body1.frame: Firstly, [debai] is considered as a convenient way to [V]. People have more opportunities to...
body1.point: Tourism development helps boost economic development and improve people's living standard by creating local jobs, while also helping visitors understand local people, culture, and tradition.

body2.example: For example, several popular beaches suffer from heavy plastic trash and noisy traffic during holidays, which harms sea life and makes quiet towns lose their traditional lifestyle.
body2.focus: Negative impacts: environmental pollution and loss of local culture
body2.frame: Secondly, [debai] has a negative impact on... People may face various unexpected problems.
body2.point: Too many visitors produce plastic waste and harmful exhaust fumes, while local shops may change old traditions just to please tourists and make quick money.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, rapid tourism development has both pros and cons: while it boosts economic development and improves living standards, it can harm the environment and local culture; therefore, the government should introduce stricter rules to protect nature and traditions.

intro.ld1: boost economic development and improve people's living standard
intro.ld2: environmental pollution and damage to local culture

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.4: Formal Email Replying to Hotel Customer Service Feedback Request
Nội dung chi tiết:
You recently stayed at a hotel and have received an email from the hotel's Customer Service Department asking for your feedback. Write a formal email responding to the hotel:

- Say whether you were satisfied with the service and share what activity you enjoyed most during your stay
- Suggest what the hotel could improve to provide a better experience next time
- State whether you would recommend this hotel to other travelers and explain why
title: Task 1.4: Formal Email Replying to Hotel Customer Service Feedback Request
content:
You recently stayed at a hotel and have received an email from the hotel's Customer Service Department asking for your feedback. Write a formal email responding to the hotel:

- Say whether you were satisfied with the service and share what activity you enjoyed most during your stay
- Suggest what the hotel could improve to provide a better experience next time
- State whether you would recommend this hotel to other travelers and explain why

body.answer: I'm happy to hear that you care about my stay. Overall, I was very satisfied with your friendly staff, and the activity I enjoyed most was the morning yoga class by the hotel swimming pool.
body.example: The receptionists greeted me warmly every morning, and the outdoor yoga session at 7:00 AM made me feel refreshed and energetic all day.
body.reason: This activity was beneficial to my physical health and advantageous to my mental health because it helped me relieve stress and reduce fatigue.
body.requirement: Say whether you were satisfied with the service and share what activity you enjoyed most during your stay

body.answer: However, the one issue I encountered was slow Wi-Fi in my room at night, so I believe you should upgrade the internet connection on the upper floors.
body.example: For instance, adding a Wi-Fi router in each hallway would solve the problem of weak signals inside guest bedrooms.
body.frame: E. Provide Problem + G. Provide Instruction / Suggestion
body.reason: Having fast, stable internet plays an essential role for guests who need to check work emails or join online meetings in the evening.
body.requirement: Suggest what the hotel could improve to provide a better experience next time

body.answer: From my point of view, I would definitely recommend your hotel to other travelers, especially families and tourists looking for a relaxing break.
body.example: In fact, I have already told two colleagues who are visiting the city next month to book a room at your hotel.
body.reason: This is because your hotel offers clean rooms, delicious local breakfast, and a quiet, cozy environment that fits comfortably within a reasonable budget without sacrificing quality.
body.requirement: State whether you would recommend this hotel to other travelers and explain why

closing.topic: my feedback on your hotel service

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.4: Problems and Solutions of Internet Use in Modern Life
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Using the internet brings tremendous convenience and learning opportunities to modern society, yet it also causes serious concerns such as online addiction, cybercrime, and misinformation."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the key problems associated with internet use and proposing practical solutions to address them.
title: Task 2.4: Problems and Solutions of Internet Use in Modern Life
content:
Read the following statement:

"Using the internet brings tremendous convenience and learning opportunities to modern society, yet it also causes serious concerns such as online addiction, cybercrime, and misinformation."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the key problems associated with internet use and proposing practical solutions to address them.

body1.example: For instance, my friend clicked a fake bank link sent on social media and lost his savings, while many students stay up late scrolling videos and feel tired in class.
body1.focus: Key problems: internet addiction, cybercrime, and false information
body1.frame: Obviously, this trend can lead to several serious problems. First of all, [debai] directly affects... As a result, this can cause a lot of trouble, such as...
body1.point: Spending too much time online causes internet addiction and hurts study or work, while sharing private details or clicking strange links allows cyber criminals to steal bank accounts and spread false news.

body2.example: For example, universities and local police hold online safety talks to teach students how to check news sources and protect their bank passwords.
body2.focus: Practical solutions: Giải pháp A (Penalize - Individual + Government)
body2.frame: To deal with these problems, we need to take several practical steps (Giải pháp A: Cá nhân + Chính phủ).
body2.point: Each individual must build good self-discipline and think things through calmly to stay on the safe side, while the government must introduce stricter rules, heavy fines for cybercrime, and community education campaigns.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, although heavy internet use causes problems like addiction, cybercrime, and false information, combining personal self-discipline with stricter government rules and education campaigns can make online life much safer.

intro.ld1: online addiction, cybercrime, and false information
intro.ld2: personal self-discipline and stricter government rules

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.5: Informal Email Advising a Friend on Organizing an End-of-Term Party
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from a friend you have not seen for a long time. Knowing that you are good at planning events, they ask for your advice on organizing an end-of-term class party. Write an informal email responding to your friend:

- Suggest a suitable venue for the end-of-term party
- Advise whether to invite only classmates or allow classmates to bring friends along
- Recommend an appropriate dress code and fun activities for the party
title: Task 1.5: Informal Email Advising a Friend on Organizing an End-of-Term Party
content:
You have received an email from a friend you have not seen for a long time. Knowing that you are good at planning events, they ask for your advice on organizing an end-of-term class party. Write an informal email responding to your friend:

- Suggest a suitable venue for the end-of-term party
- Advise whether to invite only classmates or allow classmates to bring friends along
- Recommend an appropriate dress code and fun activities for the party

body.answer: There are two suggestions that I would like to make, and first, I believe you should book a private room at a cozy garden restaurant near your campus.
body.example: For example, a rooftop or garden cafe with space for 30 people lets everyone talk, laugh, and take group photos easily.
body.frame: G. Provide Instruction / Suggestion + H. Provide Opinion
body.reason: A private dining room fits comfortably within students' budgets and offers personal privacy without distractions from noisy strangers.
body.requirement: Suggest a suitable venue for the end-of-term party

body.answer: From my point of view, I think that it is better to invite only classmates rather than letting everyone bring outside friends.
body.example: If too many strangers join, shy classmates may feel uncomfortable and stick to small corners instead of talking with the whole group.
body.reason: The main reason for this is that keeping the party within the class helps build a strong sense of belonging and lets old friends share memories through face-to-face interaction.
body.requirement: Advise whether to invite only classmates or allow classmates to bring friends along

body.answer: Why don't you choose a smart casual dress code in white and blue, and organize a music quiz plus a small gift exchange?
body.example: Each person can bring a small $5 wrapped gift for a lucky draw, and you can finish the night by singing karaoke together.
body.reason: Light casual clothes are easy for students to prepare, while fun group games help everyone relieve stress and reduce fatigue after final exams.
body.requirement: Recommend an appropriate dress code and fun activities for the party

opening.fill: some useful ideas for organizing your end-of-term class party

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages of sharing household chores among family members. Give reasons and relevant examples.
title: Task 2.5: Benefits of Sharing Household Chores in Modern Families
content:
Read the following statement:

"Traditionally, fathers were expected to be the sole breadwinners while mothers took full responsibility for household chores. Today, many people argue that sharing housework equally among all family members brings significant benefits."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages of sharing household chores among family members. Give reasons and relevant examples.

body1.example: For instance, in my family, my father cooks dinner while my mother washes clothes, so both of them can relax together and reach a healthy balance between work and family time.
body1.focus: Reducing stress and strengthening family bonds
body1.frame: Firstly, the first reason is that [ld1]. This is because nowadays people... For instance... Clearly, it is necessary to [ld1]...
body1.point: Sharing daily housework prevents mothers from carrying the entire family burden alone, helps relieve stress and reduce fatigue, and builds a strong sense of belonging through working together.

body2.example: For example, I learned how to clean my room and cook simple meals as a teenager, so living alone at university became much easier for me.
body2.focus: Teaching children practical life skills and independence
body2.frame: Secondly, it allows that [ld2]. It is because when people... For example, I was... It is clear that [ld2].
body2.point: Doing chores teaches children practical life skills such as cooking and cleaning, helping them solve daily problems independently when they grow up or live far from home.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, I agree that sharing household chores equally brings numerous positive impacts on modern families because it reduces mothers' stress, strengthens family bonds, and teaches children practical life skills.

intro.ld1: relieve mothers' stress and strengthen family bonds
intro.ld2: teach children practical life skills and independence
